Author: Aravind Kumar

 In The Supreme Court Of India

 @ Special Leave Petition (Criminal)
 No.17241/2025
 Diwakar Appellant
 Versus
 State Of M.P. Respondent
 O R D E R
1. Heard.

2. Leave granted.
3. Appellant has been arrested on 02.12.2023 in connection with Crime No.55/2023 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 409, 420, 34, 201 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code,
1860.
4.

The case of the prosecution is that the accused persons Diwakar Mishra and Chenaram are the proprietors of D.K. Trading Company and Balaji Enterprises respectively situated at Indore and alongwith the co-accused, they entered into 1 Crl.No.___ of 2025 @ SLP (Crl.) No.17241/2025 aforementioned firms to have a wrongful gain by cheating others.
It is also alleged that the co- accused helped in the registration and other formalities of the aforesaid firms.

In this factual scenario, they have purchased material in wholesale from the complainant firm  Simu Impex Pvt.
Ltd., Saroli, Gujarat who trade in wholesale textiles and the co-accused Chetan acted as an agent between the complainant  company and the companies of the accused.

It is alleged that business went on smoothly in the beginning, higher quantities of stock were ordered by accused and payment was stopped and thereby the accused persons had gained a sum of Rs.25,64,832/- and Rs.41,33,327/-.
Alleging that accused persons have wrongfully gained a sum of Rs.2.50 crores (approx.), the FIR came to be registered and the appellant came to be apprehended as noticed hereinabove.
5. On completion of the investigation, chargesheet has been filed and charges are also 2 Crl.No.___ of 2025 @ SLP (Crl.) No.17241/2025 framed by the jurisdictional Court.

Four out of sixty-three Diwakar vs State Of M.P on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120650546/
1 witnesses have already been examined.

In that view of the matter, continued incarceration of appellant would not be warranted as there is no flight risk and as such we are of the considered view that appellant deserves to be enlarged on bail and accordingly, it is ordered, which would be subject to such terms and conditions as the jurisdictional Court may impose and also with the condition that he shall appear before trial court on all the dates of hearing without fail unless exempted for any justifiable grounds to the satisfaction of trial court.
The appeal is allowed.
6. Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
